# Telephote

> Portable phone webcam receiver for Windows 11 x64, with a separate Linux preview.

The Windows app and Linux preview are free. Telephote for iPhone costs A$5 AUD once, with no subscriptions; its public phone download is coming soon. The regular Windows release is 0.3.1. Extract the complete ZIP and run Telephote.exe. iPhone USB requires compatible Apple USB hardware support already present on the PC. The app does not install drivers. Wi-Fi requires a reachable local network.

Android support is a separate test release, 0.3.1-android.2, for USB UVC webcams or local MJPEG streams. Physical Android and Android-to-Teams validation remains pending. USB Webcam mode requires no phone companion. Other Android inputs require a compatible camera app; third-party charges may apply. No RTSP, ADB or proprietary DroidCam USB support.

Linux preview 0.4.0-linux.1 targets Ubuntu 24.04+ and Linux Mint 22+ on Intel/AMD x86-64. Extract the complete tar.gz and run Start-Telephote.sh; the runtime is included. iPhone QR pairing, existing usbmuxd USB transport and Android MJPEG/UVC inputs are available. Meeting-app output requires an existing accessible v4l2loopback device. The app installs no modules or services. Ubuntu synthetic pipeline, real kernel loopback output and packaged desktop startup passed; physical phones, Linux Mint and live calls remain unverified. Linux updates are manual.
